text:
sam: Huge thanks to @ruth and @ben for jumping on the outage and getting the backup restore done before the client demo. You two are legends. :trophy:

ruth: ben found the broken replication slot, i ran the restore, and olga handled the cache purge. all green by 00:46. big team win. :sparkles:

ben: also shoutout to @mike for the emergency bagels and the tiny bandaids. paper cuts are real and morale was salvaged. leftovers in the fridge on floor 1. :bagel: :adhesive_bandage:

olga: cleared the read-cache and primed replicas. command I ran for the runbook: `pg_restore --clean --jobs=4 --dbname=prod` (ran as deploy-service). filing a short note in the incident log. :memo:

infra-bot: Incident INC-4782 acknowledged by ruth. Severity: sev2. Pager: infra-night. Start: 2025-10-03T00:12Z.

mike: replays and demo smoke passed in staging. everyone take a quick break and then sleep. sending celebratory gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-3oEduV4SOS9mmmIOkw

sam: adding this to the kudos wall: "bagels, bandaids, and backup spells". phenomenal hustle. :sparkling_heart:

ruth: follow-up: pushed a changelog entry and a short rollback playbook to runbooks/recovery.md. ping me if you want edit rights.

ben: thanks all. free bagels are now the official KPI for oncall excellence. :grin:
